description: Narrow and elongated. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. No internal corridor — fully open layout. Kitchen: single-wall, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: linear kitchen-dining-living, kitchen on side wall. Seating: Single sofa in the central living zone facing the TV/seating wall, oriented toward the windows. Dining table (4 seats). TV on wall left of entry. Cook can see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is kitchen, straight corridor, short. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) — accessed via own door off corridor, walk-in wardrobe (open two facing units). Master suite (en-suite bathroom) closest to entry — lighter acoustic separation from the arrival zone. Storage: generous wardrobe storage. Sanitary rooms: bathroom (shower and toilet); separate WC. One bathroom plus separate WC — one person can shower while another uses the toilet. Simultaneous showering not possible. Suits: singles or couples. Not suitable for: large families; households needing a home office or desk space; wheelchair users requiring wide turning corridors; people wanting a bathtub.
